Disable supersampling to speed up processing — quality remains almost unchanged.

# PhotoFlow XL DMD v2.0

This workflow has been developed to generate realistic photos with a focus on people. 

An SDXL checkpoint is required together with the DMD2 Speed LoRA.  

The DMD2 Speed LoRA can be downloaded here:  
- fp32 best quality: [https://civitai.com/models/1608870?modelVersionId=1820705](https://civitai.com/models/1608870?modelVersionId=1820705)  
- fp16 great quality: [https://civitai.com/models/1608870?modelVersionId=1820946](https://civitai.com/models/1608870?modelVersionId=1820946)  

The following SDXL checkpoints are particularly suitable:

### Installation

#### ComfyUI Manager Installation
[https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager?tab=readme-ov-file#comfyui-manager](https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager?tab=readme-ov-file#comfyui-manager)

#### Installation of Missing Nodes

Missing nodes in this workflow are highlighted in red. To install them, open the ComfyUI Manager and click on the “Install Missing Custom Nodes” button.  

#### ⚠️‼️ComfyUI-KJNodes needed‼️⚠️
It it may happen that the ComfyUI-KJNodes are not included in the list of missing nodes. Simply install the ComfyUI-KJNodes via ComfyUI Manager > Custom Nodes Manager.

After the installation, restart ComfyUI and refresh the browser page.

### Recommended Default Values

**Sampler:** lcm  
**Scheduler:** karras (beta is a good alternative)  
**Steps:** 12  
**CFG:** 1.0


### Koya Deep Shrink Default Values

Koya Deep Shrink helps eliminate distortions, such as excessively long body parts, at high resolutions, as in this workflow.

**block_number**: 4  
**downscale_factor**: *calculated from resolution to reach 1 megapixel*  
**start_percent**: 0.0  
**end_percent**: 0.5  
**downscale_after_skip**: true  
**downscale_method**: bicubic  
**upscale_method**: bicubic  

You can play with different up- and downscale methods.

### FaceDetailer

#### Default Options
**Denoise:** 0.20 (0.10 to 0.40, depends on image)  
**Steps:** 8 (4 to 12, depends on denoise and image)  
**Sampler:** lcm (euler_ancestral is a good alternative)  
**Scheduler:** karras (use normal if changes are too subtle)

💡For close-up shots of the face, the FaceDetailer can be skipped.

#### SAM Model Installation (if missing)
`sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth`: ComfyUI Mangager > Model Manager > Search for "ViT-B SAM model"

#### BBox Detector Installation (if missing)
`face_yolov8m.pt`: ComfyUI Mangager > Model Manager > Search for "face_yolov8m (bbox)"

👀If only the eyes are to be improved, change the BBox detector to:  
`Eyeful_v2-Paired.pt`: [https://huggingface.co/Tenofas/ComfyUI/blob/main/ultralytics/bbox/Eyeful_v2-Paired.pt](https://huggingface.co/Tenofas/ComfyUI/blob/main/ultralytics/bbox/Eyeful_v2-Paired.pt)  
Put the file in the `ComfyUI\models\ultralytics\bbox` directory. Lower the value in the `Skip faces smaller X px` node if the eyes are not detected.


### Recommended Upscalers

**UniversalUpscalerV2 Neutral:** absolute allround talent, improves texture, especially skin and hair without artificial look or artifacts  
**ITF SkinDiffDetail Lite v1:** adds texture, skin details and grain  


### Upscaler Downloads

Save in `ComfyUI\models\upscale_models` directory:

**UniversalUpscalerV2 Neutral:** [https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-UniversalUpscalerV2-Neutral](https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-UniversalUpscalerV2-Neutral)  
**ITF SkinDiffDetail Lite v1:** [https://openmodeldb.info/models/1x-ITF-SkinDiffDetail-Lite-v1](https://openmodeldb.info/models/1x-ITF-SkinDiffDetail-Lite-v1)  

💡 If you like a grainy analog look increase the `blend_factor` in the last Fine Tuning Group.  

### VAE Installation
Some checkpoints do not contain a VAE. The official `sdxl_vae.safetensors` can be downloaded here: [https://civitai.com/models/296576/sdxl-vae](https://civitai.com/models/296576/sdxl-vae) or [https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/sdxl-vae/tree/main](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/sdxl-vae/tree/main)  
Save it in the directory `ComfyUI\models\vae`.

### TL;DR
Check my Civitai profile for updates: [https://civitai.com/user/ai839](https://civitai.com/user/ai839)

The workflow was developed and tested with a NVIDIA RTX 4080 (16 GB VRAM) and 96 GB RAM.
